Bachelor in Business, Economics and Data Science

NHH’s international bachelor’s programme provides a solid business education with a strong focus on data science and information technology.

WHAT WILL YOU LEARN?

The curriculum covers core areas of business administration – accounting, economics, finance, marketing, and strategy.

However, the programme distinguishes itself from traditional undergraduate business degrees through a stronger emphasis on mathematics and applied statistics, as well as courses in data science, programming and application design, automation, and artificial intelligence.

You will also develop skills in ethics, sustainability, and professional communication.

PROGRAMME STRUCTURE

Good solutions to real-world business challenges typically rely on skills from several disciplines. To support appreciation of how disciplines relate, each semester is organized around a central theme, such as consumers, the firm, markets, or sustainability. While you work through individual courses, these themes integrate content across disciplines.

Data science and information technology play key roles in connecting individual subjects. Hands-on training in data science as well as the role of technology in the firm are broad themes that span multiple semesters—delivered both through dedicated courses and integrated into core business administration subjects.

FURTHER STUDIES

Upon completion of the three-year Bachelor’s degree, you are guaranteed admission to either the two-year Master’s programme in Economics and Business Administration or the Master’s programme in Accounting and Auditing (which requires proficiency in Norwegian).

The programme also provides a solid foundation for further graduate studies at other institutions or for starting a career directly after the Bachelor degree.

NO TUITION FEES FOR EU/EEA/SWISS citizens

NHH is a publicly funded university and does not charge application fees. Tuition fees apply to students holding non-EU/EEA/Swiss passports. Students from Norway, other Nordic countries, and the EU/EEA/Switzerland are exempt, in accordance with EU regulations.

READ MORE ABOUT TUITION & FINANCIAL MATTERS

CAREERS

NHH is a Triple Crown accredited business school and among the best ranked institutions in Europe.

Our graduates are highly sought after in the labour market. Surveys show that they quickly secure relevant and attractive positions, and the majority of NHH’s master’s students receive job offers before graduation.

An NHH degree provides a comprehensive and prestigious education that qualifies you for a wide range of career opportunities. 

Read more about career opportunities and former students

INTERNATIONAL OPPORTUNITIES

As an NHH student, you have excellent opportunities to gain international experience through exchange programmes and internships both at the bachelor's and master's level. NHH has an extensive network of leading international business schools, and our students are highly sought after for internships.

Read more about international opportunities

STUDENT LIFE

The NHH experience is not limited to the classrooms and study halls. Engaging in student activities, will provide you with new friends and opportunities to develop your teamwork and leadership skills.

Read more about the active student life at NHH
